title: Global solutions and large time stabilization in a model for thermoacoustics in a standard linear solid
summary: This manuscript is concerned with the one-dimensional system \[ \begin{array}{l} τu_{ttt} + αu_{tt} = b \big(γ(Θ) u_{xt}\big)_x + \big( γ(Θ) u_x\big)_x, \\[1mm] Θ_t = D Θ_{xx} + bγ(Θ) u_{xt}^2, \end{array} \] which is connected to the simplified modeling of heat generation in Zener type materials subject to stress from acoustic waves.
